confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Lisbon price levels, projected to July 2026 peak season. No live listings or supplied city context were used. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is the most seasonal and least certain. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 2.75x and 1.25x). FX came from RBA page text retrieved by search, not a live feed. 14 Oct 2026 is the latest observation I could corroborate; an unconfirmed 15 Oct figure was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Estimates were reasoned from general knowledge of central Lisbon restaurant, bar and accommodation prices, adjusted for July peak-season demand and assumed price drift into 2026, and checked against general knowledge of other large Southern European tourist cities such as Porto and Madrid.
